scope: Local in-app browser, one final run per pose after npm check finished; earlier exploratory samples varied. Not a portable GPU benchmark.
timing: Draw submission through synchronous one-pixel readback; includes driver/browser/readback overhead, not pure GPU time or FPS
configurationCaveat: Lighting/material implementations differ. Three.js static sun/spot shadow maps cached. Legacy work-light shadow pass redraws when enabled.

layers.geometry: Actual triangle face normals and procedural albedo
layers.micro: Actual face normals plus procedural microrelief only
layers.normals: Legacy broad-body normals plus analytic crater and microrelief gradients
layers.legacy: Legacy normals plus cavity color darkening

interpretation: Legacy crater-normal reconstruction was slower than the actual-geometry-plus-microrelief path in these samples. Small differences between geometry/microrelief or normal/darkening variants should not be treated as causal feature costs; run-to-run timing varies. This does not establish an engine-wide speed ranking.
appearanceCalibration: Historical measurements before light-isolation presets: all Three.js lights enabled, standard reflections. Current work-light preset disables Three.js sun and uses dimmer ambient fill; remeasure for current settings.
